name: Paper Layers
description: The second clip is rebuilt as a stack of cut paper sheets, one per band of brightness: from the darkest to the lightest, each sheet slides in lifted above the stack, drops into place with a soft shadow on the sheets below, then the paper flattens into the photo. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: layers
params.description: Number of paper sheets, one per band of brightness of the second clip

params.name: colorful
params.description: How much of the second clip's colors the paper takes (0: plain paper in shades of the paper color)

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadows the sheets cast on the ones below

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the lightest sheet of paper; the darker ones are shades of it
